subject.title: [Feature]: No way to view/manage paired contacts & permissions

question: Should OpenClaw add a terminal admin contact inventory for WhatsApp pairing and allowlists, and what fields, redaction, account scope, and admin authorization should it expose?
rationale: The source gap is real, but the requested surface exposes sender identifiers, authorization state, and activity data while overlapping `/allowlist`, `directory`, `channels status`, and the narrower approved-pairing request.

options.title: Define scoped admin inventory
options.body: Add a designed CLI/admin surface that merges pairing store, config allowlists, directory labels, and a chosen activity source under explicit redaction and account-scope rules.

options.title: Narrow to pairing management first
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/56621 for `list-approved` and `revoke`, then defer group-policy and last-active columns until their privacy and storage model is decided.

options.title: Defer to Control UI design
options.body: Keep terminal surfaces as-is and wait for a broader Control UI/admin model before adding another permission-management command.

recommendation.title: Define scoped admin inventory
recommendation.body: Add a designed CLI/admin surface that merges pairing store, config allowlists, directory labels, and a chosen activity source under explicit redaction and account-scope rules.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history signal is the overlapping `/allowlist` and allow-from store work, plus the issue needs product-boundary judgment.
